class.name: CgameMotionMatchingDatabase
class.brief_description: Pose-search database used for motion matching.

method.name: add_clip
method.description: Adds a clip described by an array of frame dictionaries (see [method frame_features]). The database must be rebuilt with [method build] afterwards.

method.name: add_clip_features
method.description: Adds a clip from a flat array of raw features, [constant DIMS] floats per frame. The size must be a multiple of [constant DIMS].

method.name: brute_force_search
method.description: Exhaustive search over all frames. Returns the same result as [method search]; useful for validation and benchmarks.

method.name: build
method.description: Normalizes the features and builds the k-means search index. Must be called after adding clips or changing [member weights].

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all clips and the index.

method.name: find_clip
method.description: Returns the index of the clip called [param name], or [code]-1[/code].

method.name: get_clip_count
method.description: Returns the number of clips.

method.name: get_clip_fps
method.description: Returns the frame rate the clip was authored at.

method.name: get_clip_frame_count
method.description: Returns the number of frames of the clip.

method.name: get_clip_name
method.description: Returns the name of the clip at index [param clip].

method.name: get_frame_count
method.description: Returns the number of indexed frames (after [method prune_redundant] this can be lower than the authored frame count).

method.name: get_stats
method.description: Returns a dictionary with [code]frames[/code], [code]dimensions[/code], [code]clips[/code] and [code]buckets[/code].

method.name: is_built
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the search index is up to date.

method.name: is_clip_looping
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the clip loops.

method.name: prune_redundant
method.description: Removes frames that are within [param threshold] (normalized, weighted distance) of an already kept frame of the same clip. Returns the number of removed frames. The pruning is not saved with the resource; it is recomputed from the stored clips on load.

method.name: query_from
method.description: Builds a query from the current character state. The future trajectory is predicted with a critically damped spring using [member spring_halflife].

method.name: retain_frames
method.description: Drops every frame whose entry in [param keep] is [code]0[/code] and rebuilds the index. Returns the number of removed frames.

method.name: search
method.description: Finds the best matching frame using the k-means index. If [param current_clip] and [param current_frame] are given, the following frame is considered with a cost multiplied by [member continue_bias]. Only clips that have all [param required_tags] are searched.

method.name: build_default_database
method.description: Returns a built database of procedurally generated locomotion clips (idle, walk, run, strafe, turn). Useful for tests and prototypes.

method.name: frame_features
method.description: Converts a frame dictionary to a feature vector. Keys: [code]root_velocity[/code] ([Vector2]), [code]root_facing[/code] ([float]), [code]trajectory[/code] (three dictionaries with [code]pos[/code] [Vector2] and [code]facing[/code] [float]), [code]left_foot[/code], [code]right_foot[/code], [code]left_foot_vel[/code] and [code]right_foot_vel[/code] ([Vector3]).

method.name: predict_facing
method.description: Critically damped spring prediction of an angle after [param time] seconds.

method.name: predict_velocity
method.description: Critically damped spring prediction of a velocity after [param time] seconds.

method.name: synthesize_locomotion_clips
method.description: Returns procedural locomotion clips as dictionaries with [code]name[/code], [code]frames[/code], [code]fps[/code], [code]loop[/code] and [code]tags[/code].

members.member: Serialized clips (name, raw features, fps, loop, tags). Setting it rebuilds the index.
Cost multiplier applied to the frame that continues the current clip.
Half-life in seconds of the spring used to predict the future trajectory in [method query_from].
Feature group weights: [code]velocity[/code], [code]facing[/code], [code]traj_pos[/code], [code]traj_facing[/code], [code]foot_pos[/code] and [code]foot_vel[/code]. Changing them rebuilds the index.

constants.constant: Number of floats in a feature vector.
